title: I`M FALLING APART
author: Nandini Mitra
text:
There`s passion and madness all around,
Let the magic begin,
Like a magician
I toss my problems up in the air,
They disappear somewhere,
Somewhere up in the blues,
My fears I surrender.

I live in each moment,
So precious,
Yet I embrace all that`s gone,
Future I see from far,
It`s as far as I can see,
Hazy and misty,
Today is what I have,
To love, believe and live.

I`m a conchshell
Carrying the sound of the waves in me
I hear the ocean in myself
But I can`t reach the place,
That has always led me on,
I wait for the dawn
Is it lost forever?

Heart cries in silence,
Loneliness broods alone,
It`s lost , it`s gone,
I search for your face ,
But I can`t reach the place
That has always led me on,
Slowly I`m falling apart,
Is it lost forever?
